decisions.quote: Unlike the findings of Cherchem (2017), the authors observed that, in addition to clan culture, hierarchical culture can also act as an enhancer of entrepreneurial strategies. On the other hand, generational involvement influences the relationship between organizational culture and the level of EO (and its dimensions), reinforcing those internal family characteristics that can foster entrepreneurial strategies in family businesses, whose findings align with Cherchem (2017).
decisions.reason: The abstract explicitly contrasts the hierarchical-culture finding with Cherchem (2017) while reporting that the moderating effect of generational involvement aligns with Cherchem (2017), which meets the codebook definition of a mixed outcome.
